name: Mahou Senshi Exceed Knights -Aratanaru Sekai no Megami-tachi-
original_name: 魔法戦士イクシードナイツ -新たなる世界の女神たち-
source:
The plan of Falke and Silva was destroyed by Mahou Senshi (Magical Warriors). The two that planned to release Metzer along with the monsters had gone disappeared. The world has once again returned to its peaceful state.

Yurise Ririna sensed that there were still invaders from the other world. She bought over Kokusaikyoudou school and introduced Magic Study curriculum to the school. She proceeded the plan to nurture successful students and to provide the training ground for the future generation of Mahou Senshi. Sawatari Kei was one of the school's normal course's students, but he advanced to Magic Study course with his excellent academic results. There, he met Masaki Momoka, his classmate, and Saimeiji Shion, a student council member. Kei who thought that he wouldn't be able to keep up with all the lessons mysteriously understood everything.

One day, Kei met a girl named Noel who is 『the agent of Cocono Aqua』. He learned that there is a highly restrictive institution that keeps Seireiseki (Holy Tear Stone), a stone that has the power to give birth to Mahou Senshi, and that he could obtain its power. Noel informed Kei that "you have the special blood that would allow you to control the world running through your veins". And with the power to make Mahou Senshi as his pawn, Kei urged for the world domination.

After that, Kei gave the power and transformed Momoka and Shion, who were attacked by monsters, into Mahou Senshi. With the realization of his ambition, Kei determined to manipulate the new born warriors while fighting against the previous generation of Mahou Senshi.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1068851]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
法尔克和席尔瓦的计划被魔法战士破坏了。原本打算将梅泽和怪物一起释放的两人已经消失了。世界再次恢复平静。

尤丽丝莉莉娜察觉到还有来自异世界的入侵者。她收购了国际学校，并将魔法学习课程引入学校。她继续实施培养成功学生的计划，并为下一代魔法战士提供训练基地。泽渡圭是学校普通科的学生之一，但他以优异的成绩升入魔法研究科。在那里，他结识了同班同学桃花正树和学生会成员西明寺紫苑。以为自己无法跟上所有课程的惠神秘地明白了一切。

有一天，惠遇见了一位名叫诺艾尔的女孩，她是“可可诺阿库娅的经纪人”。他得知，有一个严格限制的机构，保存着圣泪石（圣泪石），这是一种具有催生魔法战士力量的石头，他可以获得它的力量。诺埃尔告诉凯“你的血管里有一种特殊的血液，可以让你控制世界”。并以魔法战士为棋子的力量，祈力主宰世界。

之后，惠赋予了力量，将受到怪物攻击的桃花和紫苑变成了魔法战士。实现了自己的野心后，圭决定操纵新生的武士，同时与上一代魔法战士作战。
